pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the primary trade has achieved a minimum +$5.00 unrealized profit and volatility expansion confirms trend continuation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 1.5 ATR price displacement away from local liquidity pools prior to order submission to avoid mean-reversion wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once profit crosses +$10.00 to force execution into the $15-$30 asymmetrical return window.
